subject: sargent
name: Ships
title: John Singer Sargent — White Ships (1908), bow and anchor detail

styleSelection.reason: Sargent's watercolor relies on luminous bare paper, crisp value boundaries between sunlit and shadowed hull planes, and decisive brushwork without ink outlines.

families.referenceCue: Sunlit warm-white hull on the right with pale blue-grey horizontal shadow bands
Sweeping curved ship bow in cool cerulean and ultramarine grey-blue shadow
Dark oval hawsehole and warm raw/burnt sienna rust and chain streaks along the stem
Two dark hanging round fenders and diagonal golden-ochre spar on the right hull
Warm cream foreground anchor on the left, deep waterline shadow under the bow, and turquoise-olive ripples on the right

reserves.reason: Brightest warm-cream highlight on the foreground anchor arm

focalPoints.label: Hawsepipe and anchor chain on bow
focalPoints.treatment: Crisp dark hawsehole opening with warm raw-sienna and burnt-sienna rust and chain accents against the cool blue-grey bow

focalPoints.label: Dark round fenders and diagonal mast on right hull
focalPoints.treatment: Two dark brown-black fenders hanging high on the sunlit hull beside the warm ochre diagonal spar

focalPoints.label: Left foreground sunlit anchor
focalPoints.treatment: Warm cream and yellow-ochre anchor fluke emerging from the cool blue-grey shadow of the lower left hull

regions.label: Sunlit white hull on the right with pale blue-grey horizontal shadow bands
regions.notes: Keep luminous paper white with whisper-light horizontal washes of cool grey-blue and warm ochre

regions.label: Sweeping curved ship bow in cool cerulean and ultramarine shadow
regions.notes: Broad sweeping diagonal and curved washes following the flare of the bow, layered from pale cerulean-grey to deeper ultramarine-grey

regions.label: Warm sienna rust streak, hawsehole, and upper stem detail
regions.notes: Rich warm orange-sienna accents along the stem edge and below the dark hawsehole

regions.label: Dark hanging fenders and warm ochre diagonal mast/spar
regions.notes: Compact dark accents for the two round fenders and decisive diagonal strokes for the golden-ochre spar

regions.label: Deep waterline shadow under the bow and turquoise-olive ripples on the right
regions.notes: Horizontal turquoise, olive-green, and dark sepia/Paynes grey strokes at the base of the hull with reserved pale ripple bands

valueGroups.name: White paper and sunlit hull highlights
valueGroups.approach: Leave mostly bare cream paper on the sunlit right hull, anchor arm, and water ripple gleams

valueGroups.name: Pale cool shadow washes and light warm timber
valueGroups.approach: Broad fluid washes establishing the cool blue-grey shadow across the bow and soft horizontal shadow stripes on the sunlit right hull

valueGroups.name: Mid-tone blue-grey hull modeling, sienna rust, and green-turquoise water
valueGroups.approach: Directional strokes following the hull curvature, warm burnt/raw sienna along the bow stem and diagonal spar, and horizontal sap-green/cerulean water bands

valueGroups.name: Deep hull shadow, lower left anchor backdrop, and dark water
valueGroups.approach: Concentrated mid-dark washes under the bow flare, around the foreground anchor, and along the waterline

valueGroups.name: Hawsehole, hanging fenders, and deepest waterline accents
valueGroups.approach: Crisp, high-pigment darks with a smaller brush for the oval hawsehole, the two round fenders on the right, and the dark base of the bow
